name: Anthropic
intro: Anthropic went from roughly $87M annualized at the start of 2024 to a $65B+ revenue run rate by July 2026 — the steepest large-scale revenue ramp ever recorded in software. Every reported ARR, funding and valuation number is collected below, each traced back to a public source.

modelTitle: How API Tiers and Enterprise Deals Add Up.
modelParagraphs: Anthropic monetizes through two engines: usage-based API pricing from $1 to $25 per million tokens across the Opus, Sonnet and Haiku model families, and consumer/enterprise subscriptions from $20/month Pro to $200/month Max plus custom enterprise seats. Claude Code — the agentic coding product — alone passed a $2.5B run rate by February 2026, and from June 2026 its programmatic usage moved to a dedicated credit pool billed at full API rates.

The enterprise and coding segments carry the growth: Frontier-model API contracts with large enterprises and cloud resales (AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex) dominate, with developer-tooling spend the fastest-compounding slice. That mix is what pushed revenue from ~$1B to $65B+ annualized in under two years.
revenueMix: Per-token pricing from $1–$25 per million tokens, the largest slice of revenue.
Claude Code passed a $2.5B run rate within a year of launch.
$20–$200/month plans plus custom enterprise agreements and cloud resale.

faqs.a: Anthropic's annualized revenue run rate topped $65 billion by the end of July 2026, up from ~$9 billion at the end of 2025 and ~$1 billion a year before that. That implies roughly $5.4 billion of monthly recurring revenue.

faqs.q: How Fast Did Anthropic Reach $100M ARR?
faqs.a: About 12 months after the March 2023 Claude launch — fast for an enterprise API business, though well behind consumer-viral companies like Lovable (8 months) on the same metric.

$965 billion post-money as of its May 2026 round, following a $13 billion Series F at $183 billion in September 2025 and a $30 billion raise at $380 billion in early 2026 — one of the fastest private-market re-ratings on record.

Two ways: usage-based API billing at $1–$25 per million tokens, and subscriptions from $20/month Pro to $200/month Max plus enterprise agreements. Claude Code alone exceeded a $2.5 billion run rate by February 2026.

faqs.q: Did Anthropic Overtake OpenAI in Revenue?
faqs.a: On several trackers, yes — at least temporarily. Anthropic crossed a $30B annualized run rate in early 2026 while OpenAI's standalone run rate sat near $25B in February 2026; both figures are third-party or press-reported, not audited.
